company.name: Acme Labs
company.shortDescription: Acme is a merchant network like Visa, but for loyalty points. Earn points at one merchant and spend them at others with one simple tap.
company.description: What if earning points at one merchant and spending them at others was as easy as using Apple Pay? Meet Acme – an innovative merchant network - similar to Visa, but for loyalty points. Acme simplifies earning and redeeming loyalty points across a wide network merchants to one tap, allowing everyone to earn more.
